description: An aerial or satellite photograph depicting agricultural land, with a specific rectangular parcel outlined by a magenta border. The highlighted parcel displays characteristics consistent with a vineyard, showing rows of vegetation and areas of exposed soil. Surrounding the magenta-bordered area are other cultivated fields and some artificial structures, possibly buildings, visible in the upper-left quadrant. The image appears to use a false-colour infrared band combination, where healthy vegetation exhibits shades of red or magenta (for instance, the field in the upper-right and within the highlighted area), while bare soil or impervious surfaces like buildings and roads appear in bluish-grey or green tones. The resolution is high enough to distinguish individual land parcels and structures.
